# Md Abir

> Portfolio of Md Abir, a data and AI engineer and product builder based in Erlangen, Germany. His work covers data engineering, applied AI, LLM applications, workflow automation, financial technology, and software for real operating environments.

## Selected work

- [RyoGas case study](https://abirkhan.pro.bd/work/ryogas): An offline-first fuel station sales and reporting platform built for low-connectivity operations in Bangladesh.
- [Friends and Fund case study](https://abirkhan.pro.bd/work/friends-and-fund): A role-based savings and deposit platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL, and Row Level Security.
